changes.title: Commerce Order Management API (47 endpoints, no replacement) blocked on v26.0+ and removed from all versions on Oct 27, 2026

source.quote: The affected surfaces are removed from all remaining versions on October 27, 2026. No replacement API is available.

changes.title: Rights Manager owner fields deprecated in favour of RightsHolderOwner-typed fields (v26.0+)

source.quote: The `reference_owner`, `matched_reference_owner`, `sending_rights_holder`, and `receiving_rights_holder` fields are deprecated.

changes.title: Legacy Graph API protocol features (pretty, debug, date_format, GET /?ids=, If-None-Match/ETag) ignored or erroring on v26.0+, all versions Oct 27, 2026

source.quote: Requests that include `date_format` return an error.

changes.title: Legacy Page fields removed for New Pages Experience pages on v26.0+ (all versions about 90 days after launch, date TBC)

source.quote: For New Pages Experience pages, the `current_location`, `genre`, `network`, `parking`, and `start_info` fields are deprecated because they are no longer maintained.

changes.title: Delivery Estimate fields daily_outcomes_curve, budget_guardrail, estimate_dau removed (v26.0+, all versions Oct 27, 2026)

source.quote: The `daily_outcomes_curve`, `budget_guardrail`, and `estimate_dau` fields are removed from Delivery Estimate responses because the service powering these values has been deprecated.

changes.title: HEC-F ad sets with relaxable targeting must explicitly set targeting_automation.advantage_audience on v26.0+ (all versions once v25.0 deprecated, date TBD)

source.quote: Omitting the field returns `ADS_TARGETING__REQUIRE_EXPLICIT_ADVANTAGE_AUDIENCE_FLAG`.

changes.title: Instagram Explore Feed ad placement removed; requests specifying it error on v26.0+

source.quote: The Instagram Explore Feed placement is no longer available.

changes.title: Creatives with applink_treatment=web_only can no longer be attached to Web+App campaign ads (v26.0+, all versions Oct 27, 2026)

source.quote: A creative with `applink_treatment=web_only` can no longer be attached to an ad in a campaign using Website and App conversion locations.

changes.title: Messenger Stories placement (story in messenger_positions) removed on v26.0+ and for all versions Oct 27, 2026

source.quote: The `story` value in `messenger_positions` is silently removed for versioned v26.0 or later calls and no longer appears in effective placements.

changes.title: Poll ad creation (poll_spec, poll under interactive_components_spec) unavailable on v26.0+, all versions Oct 27, 2026

source.quote: The `poll_spec` field and `poll` type under `interactive_components_spec` are unavailable.

changes.title: From v26.0 eligible ad creatives default to destination_type WEBSITE_AND_SHOP when advertiser has a shop; opt out with WEBSITE_AND_SHOP_OPT_OUT

source.quote: Starting in API v26.0, eligible ad creatives will automatically default to destination_spec.destination_type = WEBSITE_AND_SHOP when the advertiser has a shop.

changes.title: Graph API v26.0 and Marketing API v26.0 released; callers should move to v26.0

source.quote: **Released** July 29, 2026 | **Available until** TBD

changes.title: Graph API v20.0 expires; calls are served by the oldest available version

source.quote: **September 24, 2026:** Graph API v20.0 is deprecated and removed.

changes.title: Graph API v21.0 expires on January 21, 2027

source.quote: **January 21, 2027:** Graph API v21.0 is deprecated and removed.

changes.title: Marketing API v24.0 expiry (sources conflict: Oct 6, 2026 on Graph changelog vs Nov 10, 2026 on Marketing changelog)

source.quote: Marketing API version auto-upgrade will release on July 29, 2026.

changes.title: Marketing API v25.0 expiry listed as February 23, 2027 on Marketing changelog (TBD on Graph changelog)

source.quote: | [v25.0](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/ads-commerce/marketing-api/marketing-api-changelog/version25.0) | February 18, 2026 | February 23, 2027 |

changes.title: Page, post, video and story unique impression/reach insights metrics error on all versions after v26.0 release; some have replacements (page_total_media_view_unique, post_total_media_view_unique, STORY_MEDIA_VIEW)

source.quote: Once deprecated, these metrics will return an error if requested using any API version.

changes.title: Node metadata query parameter (metadata=1) deprecated for all versions May 19, 2026

source.quote: The [metadata query parameter](https://developers.facebook.com/docs/graph-api/overview#node-metadata) (`metadata=1`) is deprecated and will no longer return metadata about supported fields for the targeted node.

changes.title: Webhooks mTLS certificate signed by new Meta-owned CA from March 31, 2026; servers verifying it must trust meta-outbound-api-ca-2025-12.pem

source.quote: Failure to update your trust store by March 31, 2026, will result in TLS handshake failures, and your servers will stop receiving all webhooks events.

changes.title: Creation, duplication and updates of Advantage+ Shopping and App Campaigns disallowed for all versions May 19, 2026

source.quote: Creation, duplication, and updates to [Advantage+ shopping campaigns](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/ads-commerce/marketing-api/advantage-shopping-campaigns) and [Advantage+ app campaigns](docs/app-ads/advantage-app-campaigns/) is no longer allowed.

changes.title: Failed async ad reports return new error fields; error_code type changes from uint to int (v25.0+)

source.quote: For any developers with access to the `error_code` field, the type will be changed from `uint` to `int`.

changes.title: Marketing API access tier renamed and approval thresholds changed (Limited/Full access; auto-approval 500 calls in 15 days)

source.quote: Auto-approval threshold lowered: 1,500 → 500 Marketing API calls in 15 days

changes.title: Updates to flagged custom audiences/custom conversions, and campaigns/ad sets using them, fail on all versions from Jan 6, 2026; lookalike_spec must match valid types

source.quote: Updating [customer file custom audiences](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/ads-commerce/marketing-api/audiences/guides/custom-audiences) that are [flagged custom audiences](https://developers.facebook.com/documentation/ads-commerce/marketing-api/reference/custom-audience#flagged) will fail.

changes.title: Meta Business SDK v26.0.0 released (Commerce Order Management removal, Explore/Messenger Stories placement removal, CAPI Parameter Builder)

source.quote: The Commerce Order Management API (47 endpoints) is fully deprecated with no replacement.

changes.title: Facebook Platform SDK v20.0 deprecated Sept 2026 and v21.0 Jan 2027

source.quote: **Jan, 2027:**: Facebook Platform SDK v21.0 will be deprecated
